name: std::optional<T>::value

declarations.code:
constexpr T &value() &;

constexpr const T &value() const &;

constexpr T &&value() &&;

constexpr const T &&value() const &&;

intro:
If *this contains a value, returns a reference to the contained value.

Otherwise, throws a std::bad_optional_access exception.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A reference to the contained value.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: std::bad_optional_access if *this does not contain a value.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The dereference operator operator*() does not check if this optional contains a value, which may be more efficient than value().
